about_the_game:
The Little Problems Demo invites players to delve into three cases in a world where detective work is about connecting with friends, understanding the small yet significant issues of daily life, and finding joy in the simplicity of resolution. This game isn't about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one little problem at a time.

This charming title, inspired by the acclaimed "The Case of the Golden Idol," challenges players to solve mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems.
